name: Diarrhea
overview: Diarrhoea is frequent loose stools, often acute and self-limiting from infections. In India, contaminated food and water are common causes; dehydration is the main danger, especially in children.
symptoms: Three or more loose stools per day
diagnosis: Clinical assessment of duration and severity
Stool culture if bloody, prolonged, or outbreak
treatment: Zinc supplementation in children per WHO
Antibiotics only for confirmed bacterial dysentery or specific pathogens
prevention: Proper food storage in hot climate
complications: Persistent diarrhoea and malnutrition in children
emergencySigns: Sunken eyes, dry mouth, lethargy in children
Blood in stool with high fever
Signs of shock — cold extremities, weak pulse

faq.question: Can I rely on this Diarrhea information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Diarrhea symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
